sn35.122:1.1: Saṃyojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saṃyojanañ ca || tam suṇātha || || Katame ca bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā katamaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || || Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ime vuccanti bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā || || Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || Santi bhikkhave sotaviññeyyā saddā || || Ghānaviññeyyā gandhā || || Jivhāviññeyyā rasā || || Kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā || || Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā || || Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanan ti || ||
